title: Utility Line Protection Plans Service Request Intake Standard
content:
# Service Request Intake Standard

Customer care center standard for line service requests on the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Line service requests are accepted only while the plan status is active. Line plans carry no service call fee and no deductible. A request names one line. A failure of a section repaired under the plan reported no later than the plan's repair guarantee days in calendar days after that repair was completed is a recall of the original occurrence, not a new occurrence. A request is an emergency when the failure stops water, sewer, electrical or gas service to the home, or a line is actively leaking or a gas leak is suspected; a suspected gas leak is first reported to the gas utility and 911.

## Acceptance by plan status

| Plan status on Bridgewell's record | Line service request accepted |
|---|---|
| active | yes |
| waiting period | no |
| suspended for nonpayment | no |
| expired | no |
| cancelled | no |

## Classifying the request

- **One line per request.** Each request names one line.
- **Recall or new occurrence.** A failure of a section repaired under the plan, reported no later than the repair guarantee period after that repair was completed, is a recall of the original occurrence. *Boundary case:* a failure of the repaired section reported on the last day of the guarantee period is a recall.
- **Emergency or routine.** The request is an emergency when any one of these holds: the failure stops water, sewer, electrical or gas service to the home; a line is actively leaking; a gas leak is suspected.

## Charges

No service call fee and no deductible apply to a line service request.

## Suspected gas leak

A suspected gas leak is an emergency, and it is first reported to the gas utility and 911.
